_comment: MCP resource spec for #38 Founder-mode vs Hire-PM. Phase 2 .mcpb bundle target. Draft — MCP Apps spec (Jan 2026) is young; owner to validate before locking.

resource.name: Founder-mode vs Hire-PM
resource.description: Four-input diagnostic for founders. Returns one of four verdicts (stay founder-mode, hire APM, hire mid-PM, hire head of product), what good looks like at that level, and the cost of getting it wrong.

tools.name: founder_mode_vs_hire_diagnose
tools.description: Deterministic. Returns the verdict from the four inputs. Does not call an LLM.

tools.name: founder_mode_vs_hire_narrate
tools.description: LLM-narrated. Takes the verdict and inputs, returns three sections: verdict in plain language with rationale, what good looks like at that level, cost of getting it wrong.

user_inputs.description: The four original inputs verbatim so narration can reference specifics.

tools.name: founder_mode_vs_hire_drift
tools.description: MCP-only (stateful). Compares the current verdict to a previous run and reports what shifted. Default off — requires opt-in.
tools._phase_note: Web/URL-trick versions don't expose this tool. State requires the MCP App AND user opt-in.
